description.en: If you are an investor, business leader, or founder, get in touch.
description.zh: 如果你是投资人、企业负责人或创业者，欢迎联系我们。

description.en: Exchange views on industries, technologies, and projects.
description.zh: 围绕行业、技术和项目交换看法。

description.en: Research and advice for an investment decision, business need, or product question.
description.zh: 针对投资判断、企业需求或产品问题提供研究与建议。

description.en: Stay involved over time as you set direction, design an approach, and move the project forward.
description.zh: 在一段时间内持续参与方向判断、方案设计和项目推进。

description.en: Work together toward a defined goal in research, development, or technology transfer.
description.zh: 围绕明确目标共同开展研究、开发或科技转化。
